name: Màoxiǎn Shíguāngjī
summary: A 2D horizontal board gameGame mechanism: players can freely switch between melee and long-range attacks to defeat NPC.This game adopts retro pixel stylePlayer operation: A: move left; D: move right; space: jump; J: normal attack; K: skill attack (prerequisite)

name: Mànyóu Wǔ Qiānnián
summary: "Roaming Five Thousand Years" is a casual game that combines strategy, tower defense and placement elements. It is based on the Three Kingdoms and incorporates traditional Chinese elements. Players mainly recruit and train generals, build tower defenses to resist enemy invasions, and manage resources to improve overall combat power.
